cases.testName: [GOV-944-SENS-RUN-ALLOW] A sensitivity break exists only in the memory of the test process and yields a complete record while the live files stay unchanged
[GOV-944-SENS-RUN-DENY] Only a break that fails the named test with an assertion produces a record; every other break or spec is refused and writes nothing

[GOV-944-VAL-RECORD-ALLOW] An in-memory record with a current break spec is accepted, and a legacy contract's record is validated as before
[GOV-944-VAL-RECORD-DENY] A non-legacy governance report refuses a critical sensitivity record that cli.mjs sensitivity did not make
